newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Galore says can't explain shr trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Galore says can't explain shr trade.

text.p: About 10 percent of the issued capital of barbeque maker Galore Group Ltd changed hands in Friday morning trade, but a spokesman for Galore said he was unaware of the reason behind the trade.
By 12.30 p.m. (0130 GMT), about 8.07 million Galore shares has traded with the share price up 0.5 cents up at 39 cents after they had touched a new year high of 39.5 cents.
The Galore spokesman said he was not sure whether the trade was in connection with the group's planned capital reduction programme.
Under the plan Galore will be privatised by cancelling all shares not held by certain executive directors, for a payment of 40 cents per share.
This will involve a total pay-out of A$20 million if shareholders approve the capital reduction at the company's annual meeting on November 18.
